mapping.summary: AI accounts payable platform that captures, matches, approves and posts vendor invoices
claims: Takes invoices from email, SharePoint, OneDrive, Google Drive, upload or vendor portal
AI extracts vendor, invoice number, date, amount and line fields
Shows confidence scores for extracted data that needs review
Bulk uploads processed through scheduled batch jobs
Two-way matching of invoices to purchase orders on quantity, price and item
Exceptions routed for correction before posting
Email alerts on invoice and approval events
Role-based access, SSO and two-factor authentication
Dashboard for invoice status, approvals, exceptions and posting
Validated invoices posted directly to Business Central
AP assistant in Teams and WhatsApp answers invoice and PO questions
Non-PO invoice workflows available as an optional service
